name: Banner
summary: Message across the full width of the page, above the content: maintenance, missing details, a new feature.
use: Something that applies to the whole page or the whole portal.
avoid: Messages for a form or a block: use Alert.
Confirmation after an action: use Toast.
figmaProps: Brand, Gray, Info, Warning, Error, Success
reactProps: status for a banner that shows up after an action. Leave it out if the banner is there when the page loads.
behaviour: Stays until the user closes it or the problem is solved.
On mobile the action goes below the text.
a11y: Color is not the only signal: icon and text too.
Close button with a clear name, like "Close message".
content: The title says what is going on, the text says what to do.
do: At most one banner at a time.
dont: A banner for marketing: use a Card.
